nights.title: Sleaford Mods - „The Demise Of Planet X”
nights.name: Sleaford Mods
nights.extract: Sleaford Mods are an English post-punk music duo, formed in 2007 in Nottingham. The band features vocalist Jason Williamson and, since 2012, instrumentalist Andrew Fearn. They are known for their abrasive, minimalist musical style and embittered explorations of austerity-era Britain, culture, and working class life, delivered in Williamson's East Midlands accent. The duo have released several albums to critical praise.

en.who: Sleaford Mods are an English post-punk music duo, formed in 2007 in Nottingham. The band features vocalist Jason Williamson and, since 2012, instrumentalist Andrew Fearn.
facts: They are known for their abrasive, minimalist musical style and embittered explorations of austerity-era Britain, culture, and working class life, delivered in Williamson's East Midlands accent.
The duo have released several albums to critical praise.

de.who: Sleaford Mods sind ein englisches Post-Punk-Duo, das 2007 in Nottingham gegründet wurde. Die Band hat den Sänger Jason Williamson und seit 2012 den Instrumentalisten Andrew Fearn.
facts: Sie sind für ihren abrasiven, minimalistischen Stil und ihre verbitterten Auseinandersetzungen mit dem Großbritannien der Sparpolitik, der Kultur und dem Arbeitermilieu bekannt, vorgetragen im Akzent der East Midlands.
Das Duo hat mehrere Alben veröffentlicht, die von der Kritik gelobt wurden.

tr.who: Sleaford Mods, 2007'de Nottingham'da kurulmuş İngiliz bir post-punk müzik ikilisidir. Grupta vokalist Jason Williamson ve 2012'den beri enstrümantalist Andrew Fearn yer almaktadır.
facts: Aşındırıcı, minimalist müzik tarzları ve austerity dönemi Büyük Britanya, kültür ve işçi sınıfı yaşamı üzerine öfkeli incelemeleriyle tanınırlar; bunları Williamson'ın East Midlands aksanıyla seslendirirler.
İkili, eleştirmenlerce beğenilen birkaç albüm yayımlamıştır.

nights.name: Airbag
nights.extract: Airbag is an Argentine hard rock band formed in Buenos Aires in 1999, consisting of three brothers: Patricio Sardelli, Gastón Sardelli, and Guido Sardelli. They have released eight studio albums and two live albums, and tour mostly around Latin America.

nights.title: Machine Girl
nights.name: Machine Girl
nights.extract: Machine Girl is an American electronic music project created in 2012 by Matt Stephenson on Long Island, New York. In 2015, the project became a duo, with Stephenson recruiting percussionist Sean Kelly to play live drums. Lucy Caputi joined in 2024 as a live guitarist and official member of the band.

nights.title: Kamelot
nights.name: Kamelot
nights.extract: Kamelot is an American power metal band from Tampa, Florida, formed by Thomas Youngblood in 1987. The Norwegian vocalist Roy Khan joined for the album Siége Perilous, and shared songwriting credit with Youngblood until his departure in April 2011. On June 22, 2012, Youngblood announced on their website that their new vocalist would be the Swedish singer Tommy Karevik, who was first featured on Kamelot's album Silverthorn as the main vocalist, co-songwriter, and lyricist.

nights.title: Klangkarussell
nights.name: Klangkarussell
nights.extract: Klangkarussell is an Austrian electronic music duo formed in 2011. The two members of the group are Tobias Rieser and Adrian Held. Their biggest hit to date is "Sonnentanz", which reached the top 10 in six countries.

nights.title: Nazareth - Right, Left & Centre Tour 2026
nights.name: Nazareth
nights.extract: Nazareth are a Scottish hard rock band formed in Dunfermline in 1968 that had many hit singles and albums in Canada, the United Kingdom, and a number of other European countries beginning in the early 1970s. The breadth of their popularity expanded internationally, including in the United States, with their 1975 album Hair of the Dog, which featured their hits "Hair of the Dog" and a cover of the ballad "Love Hurts". They have continued to record and tour internationally for more than 50 years.

facts: Ihre Popularität wuchs international, auch in den Vereinigten Staaten, mit dem Album Hair of the Dog aus dem Jahr 1975, auf dem ihre Hits „Hair of the Dog“ und eine Coverversion der Ballade „Love Hurts“ erschienen.

facts: Popülerlikleri, 1975 tarihli Hair of the Dog albümüyle Amerika Birleşik Devletleri de dahil olmak üzere uluslararası alanda genişlemiştir; bu albümde „Hair of the Dog“ ve „Love Hurts“ balladının coverı yer almıştır.
Grup 50 yılı aşkın süredir uluslararası düzeyde kayıt yapıp turneye çıkmaktadır.

nights.title: Swae Lee | Same Difference Tour Europe

nights.title: ARLO PARKS - DESIRE TOUR
nights.name: Arlo Parks
nights.extract: Anaïs Oluwatoyin Estelle Marinho, known professionally as Arlo Parks, is an English singer and songwriter. Her debut studio album, Collapsed in Sunbeams, was released in 2021 to critical acclaim and peaked at number three on the UK Albums Chart. It won the 2021 Mercury Prize for Best Album and earned her nominations for Album of the Year, Best New Artist and Best British Female Solo Artist at the 2021 Brit Awards.

nights.title: The Dumplings
nights.name: The Dumplings
nights.extract: The Dumplings are a Polish electropop duo from Zabrze, consisting of Justyna Święs and Kuba Karaś. As of 2016, they have released two studio albums. Their debut studio album No Bad Days was released in May 2014 through Warner Music. It has been hailed one of the greatest musical sensations of 2014 by the Polish media, receiving an exclusive Fryderyk award for phonographic debut of the year.

nights.title: The Ruins of Beverast
nights.name: The Ruins of Beverast
nights.extract: The Ruins of Beverast is a German blackened doom metal project formed by Alexander von Meilenwald in 2003 after the disbandment of his previous band Nagelfar. "Beverast" is Meilenwald's own derivation of the word "Bifröst", the old Norse term for the bridge between Midgard and Asgard.

nights.title: Portugal. The Man

nights.title: First Aid Kit - Visions of the Past Tour
nights.name: First Aid Kit
nights.extract: First Aid Kit is a Swedish folk duo consisting of the sisters Johanna and Klara Söderberg, born in 1990 and 1993 respectively. When performing live, they are accompanied by a drummer, a guitarist and a keyboard player. First Aid Kit started to become internationally known in 2008 with their YouTube uploaded cover of the Fleet Foxes' song "Tiger Mountain Peasant Song". In 2012 Rolling Stone magazine had their song "Emmylou" as 10th on their "Single of the Year" list. First Aid Kit has released five albums, four EPs and several singles. In 2015, they were nominated for a Brit Award as one of the five best international groups. They were nominated again in 2019 and 2023.

facts: First Aid Kit hat fünf Alben, vier EPs und mehrere Singles veröffentlicht.

nights.title: GLAIVE – GOD SAVE THE THREE TOUR
nights.name: Glaive
nights.extract: Ash Blue Gutierrez, known professionally as Glaive, is an American singer-songwriter. After posting a string of hyperpop songs to SoundCloud during the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic that earned him a following, he signed a record deal with Interscope Records and released his debut extended play, Cypress Grove, in 2020. His debut album, I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All, was released in 2023. His second album, May It Never Falter, was released in 2024. His third, Y'all, was released in September 2025. His fourth, a collaborative album with Kurtains called God Save the Three, was released in May 2026.

facts: His fourth, a collaborative album with Kurtains called God Save the Three, was released in May 2026.
His debut album, I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All, was released in 2023.

de.who: Ash Blue Gutierrez, professionell bekannt als Glaive, ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter. Zu Beginn der COVID-19-Pandemie veröffentlichte er auf SoundCloud eine Reihe von Hyperpop-Songs, die ihm eine Anhängerschaft einbrachten; danach unterschrieb er bei Interscope Records und veröffentlichte 2020 seine Debüt-EP Cypress Grove.
facts: Sein viertes Album, eine Zusammenarbeit mit Kurtains namens God Save the Three, erschien im Mai 2026.
Sein Debütalbum I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All erschien 2023.

tr.who: Ash Blue Gutierrez, sahne adı Glaive ile tanınan Amerikalı bir şarkıcı-söz yazarıdır. COVID-19 pandemisinin başlarında SoundCloud'a yüklediği hyperpop şarkılarıyla takipçi kazanmış, ardından Interscope Records ile sözleşme imzalayıp 2020'de debut EP'si Cypress Grove'u yayımlamıştır.
facts: Dördüncü albümü Kurtains ile birlikte yaptığı God Save the Three adlı ortak albümdür ve Mayıs 2026'da yayımlanmıştır.
Debut albümü I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All, 2023'te yayımlanmıştır.
